Nothing.... apart from "we are looking into it". How hard can it be to to check back a few versions to when it wasn't broken? Also... that damn awful "shuffle" button without a "play" button. author: Lewis Park

author: Deepsikha Das

author: Andy Walker

All working again now. Great experience but still feel guilty small artists don't get much money.

author: Marissa C.
body: Absolutely hate the newest interface change where My Library can only be sorted through filters, as opposed to dedicated tabs. Amazing that Spotify continues to make changes that literally no one asked for and everyone hates, whilst ignoring all the basic suggestions the majority of their user base has been giving for *years*.

author: Christian Howell
body: Decent streaming service and premium is not to expensive. However I have had a problem with the app randomly crashing. Other than that it is fine.

author: A Google user

Android auto is horrible and super buggy so I un installed it and I was pleasantly surprised to see a driving feature that ran natively on the Spotify app but to my disappointment it just randomly stopped working after a couple of days of discovering this feature.

author: Paul Richter
body: I have been a premium user for years and I am frustrated with the shuffle function repeating the same songs over and over. Also instead of only using my recent listening preferences as criteria for suggested music, I would like to have the music suggested from my overall listening history, to avoid having it only suggest rap music simply because I've listened to that the most lately. In short, I want it to suggest more genres of music from my all time listening preferences.

author: A Google user
body: It's a great idea but the app, omg. The bits it does well are superb. Massive number of songs, good learning algorithms, works well with Alexa. But... I kid you not it crashes so much. More on the phone (S9+) than Alexa, but daily and often. This is premium too. And what's going on with shuffle? I've got a playlist 1000 tracks long but no matter where I start it, it insists on playing only songs that start with numbers or the letter A. For this I pay £15 a month family account and my gf can't even use it on her phone if I'm using it on mine! What the hell is the point of a family account if only one person at a time can use it?

author: Ayush Sinha
body: The new UI just sucks and I can't find an easy way to block music/content I don't want in my feed. I have been a premium member for at least 4 years. And this is very disappointing. I am extremely dissatisfied with the direction of the App and hope that you change course as soon as possible.

author: Richard F
body: This used to be a wonderful app, but now, it is barely worth a subscription. The smart shuffle feature is one of the worst things I have ever seen, the AI 'radio' is just irritating. Songs are seemingly removed and re added randomly, the shuffle feature feels like an algorithm and it has got to the point of me being able to predict what song is next on a playlist of over 200 songs, with a runtime of over 24 hours. I miss the days of Spotify just playing music.

author: Nathaniel King
body: Terrible UI, there needs to be an option to block or hide content. I watched one episode of some popular braindead podcast and it's been haunting me ever since. *Second Edit: I contacted tech support, and the rep told me that there is no way to block an artist or podcast. Then proceeded to tell me to focus on listening to other content, because it's my fault the podcast is in my algorithm. This company does not care about the consumer's experience. $$$

author: Sonal Kokate

When an ad pops up, it automatically leaves landscape mode, and doesn't keep the screen awake, meaning if the ads last longer than your phones screen shutoff timer, your phone locks and you have to unlock it again watch the video.

They start without audio for a few seconds and then skip to the next episode (sometimes multiple episodes). Episodes are all 100% still available on the service, and have confirmed they haven't been removed. Super frustrating as I have a premium plan, might cancel if this doesn't get resolved soon.

author: Jessie

author: Healani B

What the hell Spotify. For reference I have a Android Galaxy S8.

author: Nicolas Petit-laurent

author: Vignesh Shetty

author: Johnny Crowley

author: Heaven Scott

author: Hyeshua

author: Maxwell Comer

author: Indrajit Mahapatra

author: R. Ruiz

author: Miguel Hartman

author: Unknown 1

author: Chris Verhoeven

author: Nicholas Meshberger

author: Brett Burtson

author: Sonia Garloch

author: A Google user

But at this point you're forcing users like me to get a premium account. To me, this isn't a win-win situation anymore...

author: Philip J Dennis

author: A Google user

This will not be a issue for folks tied to their devices. This issue is why only 3 stars & possible unsub in near future. On other hand it holds onto the internet very well, as in does not drop off. To each their own.

author: Avishee Verma

That app needs serious work.

author: Your Mom

body: The quality of the music streaming is amazing! The app is great but....why can't you shuffle all music? That's the one thing I really want. I get it if you are using the free version but I'm not. I'm paying £10 a month for premium, because you can't shuffle all music even on premium I can't fully recommend this to anyone.😔

author: A Google user
body: Love spotify, been a user since 2013. Since some update ~3 months ago, it KILLS my battery. Google Pixel 3 phone. Thought I had it figured out (keeping the app up instead of widget only) but as of late that doesnt work either. About fed up. Shouldnt have to charge my phone while I make dinner just so I can listen to music.
